about: 'Hope's Peak Academy—home to the nation's best and brightest high school students...and your new prison. You and your classmates have been trapped here, forced into a winner-takes-all killing game. You'll have to solve the mystery of the school to survive, but be careful what you wish for—sometimes there’s nothing more deadly than the truth...

You and your classmates at Hope's Peak Academy have been brought to Jabberwock Island by your teacher. It seems fun at first...until Monokuma returns to restart his murderous game! Solve the island's mysteries to escape!'
Online features may be terminated at any time.
